faqPage.seoDescription: Answers about membership, booking, credits, cancellations, and policies.
faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking and membership
faqPage.stillNeedHelpDesc: Our support team is happy to help

q1.q: How do I book a court at Picklevibes?
q1.a: Register as a member on our official platform first. Only registered members can log in and book courts with membership credits.

q2.a: Picklevibes is a 24-hour smart pickleball venue. Members can book any available slot through the booking system.

q3.q: How do I enter after booking?
q3.a: After confirmation, you will receive an access code or QR code. Use it at the smart door during your booked time.

q4.a: We use a credit system. Top up credits first; the system deducts credits based on the time slot you book.

q5.q: How do I top up credits?
q5.a: Log in and go to Top Up to choose a package. Multiple payment methods are available.

q6.a: Credits currently have no expiry, but we may adjust this policy and will notify members if so.

q7.q: Can I cash out unused credits?
q7.a: No. Credits are for Picklevibes courts and services only. They cannot be refunded as cash or transferred.

q8.q: If I cancel a booking, do I get credits back?
q8.a: If you cancel within the allowed window (e.g. 24 hours before start), credits are returned in full. Late cancellations may not be refundable — see the Terms.

q9.q: How do I get or use promo codes?
q9.a: We occasionally send promo codes via website, social media, or email. Enter them at checkout when booking.

q10.a: Yes. Besides standard courts, we have ball-machine practice courts for focused solo training.

q11.a: We periodically review membership and terms to improve the experience. Major changes will be announced in advance.

aboutPage.seoDescription: Our story, mission, and vision as a leading smart pickleball brand in Hong Kong.
aboutPage.title: About PickleVibes
aboutPage.subtitle: A leading smart pickleball brand in Hong Kong, making the sport accessible for everyone
story: City life moves fast, and demand for healthy social sports keeps rising. Fixed opening hours and clunky booking at traditional venues often clash with flexible schedules.
Inspired by global trends, we built Picklevibes — a local chain of 24-hour smart pickleball venues. Members can book anytime on their phones and play on their own schedule.
From booking and payment to smart door access, the journey is unmanned and automated for maximum convenience.
For players who want efficient training, we provide professional ball-machine courts for high-repetition, targeted practice.
We also offer coaching courses and social events so you can improve skills and expand your circle in a relaxed setting.
Pay by the slot with no long-term contracts — clear pricing, fair rates, and a comfortable, time-flexible way to play.
mission: With 24/7 smart self-service, we serve pickleball fans of every level and promote the sport for everyone.
Professional ball-machine courts plus all-day access let you focus on efficient, personalised training anytime.
Fully automated online booking and smart access replace traditional handovers for maximum convenience.
vision: As a market leader in Hong Kong smart pickleball venues, we aim to expand quickly so players can always find a nearby Picklevibes.
We strive to become Hong Kong’s most loved professional pickleball community hub, with continuous investment in training tech and venue systems.
Our vision is to bring this smart, convenient, high-quality experience across Asia Pacific and beyond.

termsPage.seoDescription: Picklevibes smart pickleball venue terms of service. Please read carefully; using our services means you agree to these terms.
termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully. Using our services means you agree to follow them.

items.title: 1.1 Scope of agreement
paragraphs: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) form a legally binding agreement between you (“Member” or “User”) and Picklevibes smart pickleball venues (“Company”). They apply to all services we provide, including without limitation court rental, ball-machine facilities, online booking, the membership credit system, and related facilities (“Services”).

items.title: 1.2 Acceptance
paragraphs: By registering as a member, topping up credits, or using the Services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms in full. If you disagree with any part, do not use the Services.

items.title: 1.3 Amendments
paragraphs: We may revise, change, or update these Terms at any time. Amendments take effect when posted on our website or app. Continued use after publication means you accept the revised Terms.

items.title: 2.1 Registration
paragraphs: You must register as a member to use the Services and provide true, accurate, complete, and up-to-date personal information.

items.title: 2.2 Account responsibility
paragraphs: You are fully responsible for keeping your account and password confidential and for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use.

items.title: 2.3 Age restriction
paragraphs: Persons under 18 may register and use the Services only under parental or legal guardian supervision and consent.

items.title: 3.1 Credit system
paragraphs: We charge using a credit system. Members must top up credits before booking courts or ball-machine facilities.

items.title: 3.2 Top-ups
paragraphs: Once a top-up is completed, the transaction is final. Credits purchased or topped up cannot be refunded as cash under any circumstances.

items.title: 3.3 Booking & deduction
paragraphs: When you book a court or facility, credits are deducted immediately from your account. Credit requirements may vary by time slot and facility (e.g. standard court vs ball-machine area); the booking system display prevails.

items.title: 3.4 Promo codes
paragraphs: We may issue promo codes from time to time. Use is subject to their specific terms and conditions, and they cannot be redeemed for cash.

items.title: 3.5 Cancellation policy
paragraphs: a. You must cancel within the required window before the slot starts (e.g. 24 hours) for deducted credits to be returned to your account.
b. Late cancellation or no-show: credits for that booking will not be refunded.
c. We may cancel bookings due to force majeure (e.g. severe weather, equipment failure). In such cases, credits are fully refunded.

items.title: 4.1 Self-service
paragraphs: We provide 24-hour smart self-service. Members are responsible for entry, facility use, and exit procedures.

items.title: 4.2 Entry & exit
paragraphs: You may enter via smart access only after your booked slot starts, and must leave before it ends. Overtime may incur extra charges or suspension of membership.

items.title: 4.3 Facility care
paragraphs: Members must care for courts and facilities, including nets, ball machines, and rest areas. We may recover full repair or replacement costs for damage caused by a member.

items.title: 4.4 Ball machines
paragraphs: Before using a ball machine, read and follow all operating instructions and safety rules. You are responsible for injury or equipment damage caused by improper use.

items.title: 4.5 Code of conduct
paragraphs: a. Be polite and respect other users.
b. No smoking, drinking alcohol, illegal drugs, or unlawful activity on site.
c. No pets (except guide dogs) or dangerous items.
d. Keep the venue clean; dispose of rubbish in designated bins or take it with you.

items.title: 4.6 Monitoring
paragraphs: For safety and management, venues have CCTV. You agree that we may collect and use related footage in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

items.title: 5.1 Sporting risk
paragraphs: Pickleball involves inherent risks. You acknowledge and accept all risks arising from use of the Services, including injury, property loss, or death.

items.title: 5.2 Personal belongings
paragraphs: We are not liable for personal belongings lost, stolen, or damaged on site.

items.title: 5.3 Equipment failure
paragraphs: Despite regular maintenance, temporary faults (including ball machines, A/C, lighting) may occur. We will address them promptly but are not liable for time lost, cancelled bookings, or consequential loss.

items.title: 5.4 Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or punitive damages arising from use of or inability to use the Services, even if advised of the possibility of such damages.

items.title: 6.1 Our rights
paragraphs: We may immediately suspend or terminate membership and access without refunding topped-up credits if you:
a. Breach any provision of these Terms.
b. Engage in illegal, fraudulent, or abusive use of the Services.
c. Seriously damage facilities or disrupt other members’ normal use.

items.title: 6.2 Member cancellation
paragraphs: You may request account closure through our designated process at any time. After closure, remaining credits are forfeited and cannot be refunded as cash.

items.title: 7.1 Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

items.title: 7.2 Dispute resolution
paragraphs: Disputes arising from or relating to these Terms should first be resolved amicably. If not, the parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Hong Kong courts.

items.title: 8.1 Entire agreement
paragraphs: These Terms (together with the Privacy Policy and any related service rules or guidelines) constitute the entire agreement between you and the Company regarding use of the Services.

privacyPage.seoDescription: Picklevibes personal data collection statement and privacy policy. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: Picklevibes smart pickleball venues — personal data collection statement
privacyPage.intro: Picklevibes smart pickleball venues (“Company”) is committed to complying with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (“Ordinance”) to protect the privacy, confidentiality, and security of personal data we hold. We also require all employees, officers, and agents to observe these obligations. This Personal Data Collection Statement (“Statement”) informs you how we collect, use, store, transfer, and disclose your personal data.
privacyPage.s1Title: 1. Purpose and collection of personal data
privacyPage.s1P1: We collect your personal data when you register as a member. You are not obliged to provide personal data; however, we may then be unable to process your registration or provide services.
privacyPage.s1P2: We may collect your full name, gender, birth month*, mobile number, email address and/or residential address for one or more of the following purposes:
s1Items: To provide pickleball courts, ball-machine training courts, smart access systems and/or related services;
For communications, marketing, customer relationship management and/or public relations;
For applications, creation, operation, and management of customer, member, or user accounts and records;
To handle feedback, enquiries, and complaints;
To process or request billing and payment for credit top-ups, determine outstanding amounts, and collect unpaid sums where necessary;
To identify and verify your identity, especially when entering or leaving facilities via smart access; and/or
For purposes directly related to any of the above.
privacyPage.s1Note: *Providing your birth month is voluntary. We only use it for special birthday promotions and offers.
privacyPage.s2Title: 2. Use of your personal data in direct marketing
privacyPage.s2P1: We expressly reserve the right for ourselves, our agents¹, franchisees² and/or affiliates, including subsidiaries² and associated companies³ (“Affiliates”), to use your full name, phone number, email address, and residential address (“Personal Data”) to send you direct marketing communications about goods and services that we, our agents, franchisees and/or Affiliates may offer, including pickleball, sports training, sports equipment, healthy living, and related services (“Direct Marketing Purposes”).
privacyPage.s2P2: Unless we have obtained your written consent (including an indication of no objection) before such use, we, our agents, franchisees and/or Affiliates must not use your Personal Data for Direct Marketing Purposes. If you previously consented, you may opt out in writing to info@picklevibes.com. We will not charge you for requests to stop using your Personal Data for direct marketing.
s2Notes: ¹ Agents means any agent engaged by Picklevibes for communications, marketing, CRM and/or public relations services.
² Franchisees and subsidiaries means Picklevibes-branded pickleball centres.
³ Associated companies means other sports or wellness-related brands under Picklevibes.
privacyPage.s3P1: We will take all practicable steps to keep your personal data confidential. Subject to applicable law, your personal data may be provided to the following parties for the following purposes:
s3Items: Any agent we engage for communications, marketing, CRM and/or public relations, and any franchisees and Affiliates that send direct marketing (including promoting activities and services we believe may interest members);

Any contractor or service provider that supplies services or technology related to our business and operations, including administration, telecoms, data processing, smart booking systems, payment services or technology, dispute handling and investigation, and other operational services;

Any agent, contractor or service provider that provides administrative (including member account and credit record management), technical (including IT and cloud services) or other services (including professional advisers such as lawyers and auditors) under confidentiality obligations to us;

Any person to whom we must disclose information under any law binding on or applying to us, or to comply with guidelines or codes issued by regulators or other bodies (including industry and self-regulatory bodies); and
Any actual or proposed assignee, transferee, participant or sub-participant of our rights or business.
privacyPage.s4P1: We take appropriate security measures to protect members’ personal data (including biometric data) against accidental, unlawful or unauthorised destruction, loss, alteration, access, disclosure or use.
privacyPage.s4P2: All employees, agents, franchisees, Affiliates and suppliers are bound by confidentiality. Only authorised persons may process your personal data (including biometric data) on a need-to-know basis under the Ordinance and this Statement.
privacyPage.s4AccountTitle: Account deletion by the data subject
privacyPage.s4AccountP1: You may delete a previously registered account at any time via Settings → Account security → Delete account, or by contacting online support or calling customer service.
privacyPage.s4AccountP2: After account deletion (completed within three business days), we will stop providing products or services and, upon your request, delete your personal information except where laws and regulations require otherwise.
privacyPage.s5P1: You may at any time request (i) access to or correction of your personal data; and/or (ii) to opt out of direct marketing. To exercise your rights and avoid miscommunication, please send a written request to info@picklevibes.hk. We will fulfil your request as soon as reasonably practicable.
privacyPage.s5P2: We retain your personal data only as long as needed for the purposes of collection. If you terminate membership, we will delete your personal data as soon as practicable.
privacyPage.s5P3: If there is any inconsistency between the Chinese and English versions, the English version shall prevail.
privacyPage.s6P1: All information on this page is for reference only and may change. Picklevibes does not warrant that the information here is accurate, complete or up to date, and disclaims liability for any loss or damage arising from or in reliance on the content of this page.
